# ModForge editor text: 中文（简体） (zh-Hans)
# 
# 
# Every word the editor shows is here, one text per line: key = text.
# A translation is a copy of this file with the text after each = in another
# language, named for that language: es.txt, pt-BR.txt, zh-Hans.txt...
# Language > New or update a translation, in the editor, writes one for you
# to start from.
# The texts under [In the game] are the ones the game shows players; the
# rest is the editor. One file does both: put it in the editor's languages
# folder, and in the game's BepInEx\plugins\SMSModForge\Languages folder.
# 
# Lines starting with # are notes, and [headings] only help you find your way.
# Neither changes anything.
# Keep {words in braces}, <tags> and [TOKENS:like this] exactly as they are:
# something fills them in or reads them.
# \n starts a new line. An underscore marks the letter Alt reaches a menu by.
# Nothing after the = shows the English. "" shows nothing, on purpose.
# A key ending in .one or .other is one form of a sentence with a number in it.
# A translation has the forms its own language uses; ModForge writes them out.

[This file]

# Tooltip on the 'Value' field of the SetVariable action
# en: New value. Strings round-trip as-is; use 'true' / 'false' for booleans, and numbers in invariant-culture form (e.g. '3.14'). '$varName' copies that variable's current value instead ('$$' escapes a literal dollar). Leave it blank to CLEAR the variable to an empty string — that's kept as a real value, not treated as an unfilled row.
action.setVariable.value.tip = 新值。字符串原样保存；布尔值用 'true' / 'false'，数字用固定区域性格式（例如 '3.14'）。'$varName' 则改为复制该变量的当前值（'$$' 表示一个真正的美元符号）。留空可把变量“清空”为空字符串——这会作为真正的值保存，而不是未填写的行。

# en: Active
param.label.active = 激活

CanvasGroup: 'alpha' hides the whole UI subtree without deactivating it (so anything animating underneath keeps running); 'interactable' turns its controls on or off; 'blocksRaycasts' decides whether clicks stop here or pass through to what is behind. # Tooltip on the 'Target' field of the GameObjectActive condition
# en: The object to test. Category decides how it resolves: a bust, an overlay inside a chosen level, a scene, or a raw GameObject name or hierarchy path. condition.gameObjectActive.target.tip = 要检查的对象。类别决定它如何被解析：立绘、所选关卡内的叠加层、场景，或直接的 GameObject 名称或层级路径。只要解析到的对象在层级中处于激活状态就成立；找不到的对象与关闭等同，所以“取反”意味着“关闭或不存在”，而不只是“关闭”。

# Tooltip on the 'Key' field of the InputKey condition
# en: Unity KeyCode name for the key or mouse button, e.g. Space, Mouse0, F1. Reported by POSITION rather than by the letter printed on the cap, so the letter and number rows land elsewhere on a non-US layout; the picker groups those separately.

# Label beside a field of an action or condition
# en: Chance
param.label.chance = 概率

# Tooltip on the 'Chance' field of the Random condition
# en: The chance of passing, from 0 to 1: 0.3 passes three times in ten. Rolled fresh each time it is asked, so it is offered only where a condition is asked once, like a line. For a chance that holds all day, use DailyChance.
condition.random.chance.tip = 通过的概率，从 0 到 1：0.3 表示十次里通过三次。每次被询问都会重新掷一次，所以只在条件只被询问一次的地方提供，比如一句台词。想要一整天都不变的概率，请用 DailyChance。

# Tooltip on the 'Chance' field of the DailyChance condition
# en: Probability of passing, as a whole percentage. 50 = passes on ~half of in-game days. Rolled once per in-game day: the result holds all day, survives save/reload, and changes at each day roll-over. Every DailyChance rolls independently — the console names each one after its dialogue/rule at the day change.
condition.dailyChance.chance.tip = 成立的概率，用整数百分比表示。50 = 大约一半的游戏日成立。每个游戏日掷一次：结果整天保持不变，存档/读档后仍然有效，并在每次日期切换时变化。每个 DailyChance 各自独立掷点；日期切换时，控制台会按各自的对话/规则名称逐一列出。

# Tooltip on the 'Stagger start' field of the Timer condition
# en: Wait a full interval before the FIRST fire instead of firing immediately. Use it when several rules would otherwise start together — one per character, say — so they don't all act on the same frame. Later waits are unaffected: each rule already re-rolls its own interval independently.
condition.timer.stagger.tip = 在第一次触发前先等满一个间隔，而不是立即触发。当多条规则本来会同时开始（比如每个角色一条）时，用它避免它们在同一帧全部动作。之后的等待不受影响：每条规则本来就各自重新抽取间隔。

# Text

Everything else is left untouched unless overridden above, so a bound object you haven't changed is a no-op. If the object isn't found the runtime logs a warning and skips it rather than creating a look-alike.
gameObject.componentsActiveWhenConditions = 组件、“激活条件”、子对象和 NPC 始终生效——无论如何它们都是新增内容。其余内容除非在上面覆盖，否则保持原样，因此一个你没有改动过的绑定对象什么也不会做。如果找不到该对象，运行时会记录一条警告并跳过它，而不是另造一个相似的。

# Tooltip on "_Spell-check node text"
# en: Underline misspellings using Windows' own spell checker, in the language the lines are written in - the pack's own, or the one you are editing in - both in a node's Text field and down the node list, so mistakes are visible while scanning. A language Windows has no spelling dictionary for is not underlined at all; Windows' language settings can add one. Right-click a squiggle in the Text field for suggestions, to ignore it for this session, or to add the word to your Windows dictionary (the same list Edge and Office use). Turning this off also makes the node list lighter to scroll on very long dialogues. Your choice is remembered between sessions.
menu.spellCheckNodeText.tip = 用 Windows 自带的拼写检查器，按台词所用的语言（模组包自己的语言，或你正在编辑的语言）标出拼写错误——既在节点的“文本”字段里，也在节点列表中，这样浏览时就能看到错误。Windows 没有词典的语言完全不会被标出；可以在 Windows 的语言设置中添加词典。在“文本”字段的波浪线上点击右键可以查看建议、在本次会话中忽略它，或把这个词加入你的 Windows 词典（与 Edge 和 Office 使用的是同一个列表）。关闭它也会让很长的对话中的节点列表滚动起来更轻快。你的选择会在不同会话之间保留。

# Tooltip on "Smart _suggestions in dropdowns"
# en: When you open an empty dropdown, the options that what you are editing makes likely move to the top, marked with a star: in a dialogue that mentions a character anywhere and happens at one place, a Set Active action lists that character's scenes at that place first. Everything in the dialogue, scene or rule you have up counts - the characters it names, its places, its variables, the folder it is in - and it follows your edits as you make them. Nothing is picked or hidden for you, and other dropdowns showing the same list keep their own order. Turn this off to have every list in its usual order.
menu.smartSuggestions.tip = 打开空的下拉框时，根据你正在编辑的内容判断可能性较大的选项会移到顶部，并标上星号：比如在一段任意处提到某个角色、发生在某个地点的对话里，“设为激活”动作会先列出这个角色在这个地点的场景。你打开的对话、场景或规则中的一切都算数——其中提到的角色、地点、变量、所在的文件夹——并且会随着你的编辑实时更新。不会替你选择或隐藏任何东西，显示同一列表的其他下拉框也保持各自的顺序。关闭此项，所有列表都按平常的顺序排列。

The major number is never moved for you - that one says "this is a new version of the pack", which is yours to decide. Off, the version only ever changes when you type it.
menu.versionPackAutomatically.tip = 发布模组包时自动调整版本：自上次发布以来模组包新增了内容，就升一个次版本号；只是已有的内容有改动，就升一个修订号。主版本号永远不会替你改——它表示“这是模组包的一个新版本”，由你自己决定。关闭时，版本只会在你自己输入时改变。

# Text
# en: Everything this place builds under its level, as one hierarchy. A GameObject with a Sprite is a layered sprite object (backdrop, prop, animated layer); leave the Sprite blank for a pure container that just groups children. Every node takes utility components (fade, disappear, random child, blink), nested children, and NPC placements. The NPCs node is the level's own NPCs object — always present, and the home for the NPC hierarchy; its subtree composes local transforms down the chain, so moving a container moves everything under it. Target any node from dialogue by Name with SetGameObjectActive / FadeSprite / MoveGameObject / SpinGameObject. Lower sorting draws further back.

A sound set to wait for the typewriter counts from when the typewriter reaches it.

# Tooltip on that tick
# en: For a made-up language, a spell or a chant: the words are never translated, so they cannot be turned into real words they happen to look like. In a language written in the same letters the line reads as written; in one with an alphabet of its own, like Russian or Japanese, each word is spelled out in its letters, so players can read it aloud.
dialogues.textLettersOnly.tip = 适用于虚构语言、咒语或吟唱：词语永远不会被翻译，因此不会被变成恰好相似的真实词语。在使用相同字母的语言中，这一行保持原样；在有自己文字的语言中（如俄语或日语），每个词都会用该语言的文字写出，方便玩家念出来。

# Tooltip on a part of the window
# en: The line itself. [PV:name] is replaced with a pack variable. {PC} is the player's name, and {M} {D} {B} are what this player calls their mother, father and brother — write those rather than the words, because players choose them. Markup is shown as the player will see it: the tags are set apart in their own colour and the words they wrap take their formatting. The game’s own tokens — {PC} and the rest — are marked the same way, in place, because a name goes there rather than those characters. A character's name you type becomes theirs once the word is finished: shown in their colour, it follows a new name they are given. Its small x keeps it as plain words.
dialogues.nodeTextBox.tip = 台词本身。[PV:name] 会被替换成模组包变量。{PC} 是玩家的名字，{M} {D} {B} 则是这名玩家对母亲、父亲和兄弟的称呼——请写这些标记而不是具体的词，因为它们由玩家自己选择。标记会按玩家将看到的样子显示：标签以自己的颜色单独呈现，被包住的文字带上相应格式。游戏自己的标记——{PC} 等——也以同样方式就地标出，因为那里放的是一个名字，而不是这几个字符。你输入的角色名称在这个词输完后会变成该角色的名字：以其颜色显示，并随其新名字改变。它的小 x 可以把它保留为普通文字。

# Text
# en: Runs this whole rule once per value, so one rule can cover a set of subjects instead of copying it per subject. Values: a comma-separated list (A,B,C), or $variableName naming a List variable (or a String variable holding CSV) — so the set can change at runtime. Each value is substituted wherever {name} appears in any condition or action, including branches: e.g. Location_{char} as a variable name, or {char}/Slot as a GameObject path. It composes with the rest of the syntax — $Prefix_{char} dereferences the per-value variable. Every value gets its own edge state and its own Timer deadlines, so values behave exactly like the separate rules they replace (tick 'stagger' on a Timer to spread their first fire apart). Leave blank to run the rule once.
integration.runsWholeRuleOnce = 让整条规则对每个值各执行一次，这样一条规则就能覆盖一组对象，而不必为每个对象复制一份。值可以是：以逗号分隔的列表（A,B,C），也可以是 $变量名，指向一个列表变量（或存着 CSV 的字符串变量）——这样这组值可以在运行时改变。每个值都会替换掉任何条件或动作中出现的 {name}，包括分支里的：例如把 Location_{char} 用作变量名，或把 {char}/Slot 用作 GameObject 路径。它也能和其余语法组合——$Prefix_{char} 会解引用该值对应的变量。每个值都有自己的边沿状态和自己的计时器期限，所以这些值的行为与它们所替代的那些独立规则完全一样（在计时器上勾选“错开开始”即可把它们的首次触发岔开）。留空则整条规则只执行一次。

# Tooltip on a tick box
# en: Nineteen things in rows of seven leave a last row of five, and it is normally packed against the start corner - so a grid that is even everywhere else ends lopsided. This centres that row, and only that row. Unity has no such setting, so the preview and the game both do it here.
ui.nineteenThingsRowsSeven.tip = 十九个东西按每行七个排，最后一行剩五个，通常会挤在起始的那一角——于是别处都很整齐的网格，结尾却歪了。这个选项会把那一行居中，而且只居中那一行。Unity 没有这样的设置，所以预览和游戏都在这里自己处理。

# Tooltip on a tick box
# en: With a set number of columns, the grid is only as wide as the columns its objects fill - two objects in a grid of eight columns make it two cells wide - so something sized to the grid, like a Content Size Fitter, grows and shrinks with what it holds. With a set number of rows, the same for its height. Unity's own grid is always as wide as all its columns. Only in the game: the preview draws the grid at its own size.
ui.fitToContent.tip = 列数固定时，网格只有被对象填满的那些列那么宽——八列的网格里有两个对象，就只有两格宽——所以像 Content Size Fitter 这样按网格定大小的东西会随内容伸缩。行数固定时，高度也一样。Unity 自带的网格总是所有列那么宽。只在游戏中生效：预览里网格按它自己的大小绘制。

# Tooltip on a text box
# en: Tint while the pointer is over this object, as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Leave blank for no hover feedback. The game's own hover is per-button artwork rather than a rule, so there is nothing general to copy - this is the part a pack can state.
ui.tintWhilePointerOver.tip = 指针悬停在这个对象上时的着色，格式为 #RRGGBB 或 #RRGGBBAA。留空则没有悬停反馈。游戏自己的悬停效果是逐按钮的美术资源，而不是一条规则，所以没有通用做法可抄——这正是模组包可以自己声明的部分。

# Tooltip on a text box
# en: Its size while held down, as a fraction of its own - 0.95 shrinks it a little while the pointer is down and lets it back on release, everything on it too. Empty for none: then the game's own press plays as it is clicked, once let go. Set, it stands in for that press - useful when the click closes the screen before that press could be seen.
ui.pressScale.tip = 按住时的大小，按自身大小的比例填写——0.95 表示指针按下时稍微缩小，松开时恢复，上面的东西也一起。留空表示不做：这时会在点击（松开）时播放游戏自带的按下效果。填写后会代替那个按下效果——当点击会在按下效果显示前关闭界面时很有用。

# Tooltip on a dropdown
# en: What THIS object sounds like when clicked. Blank follows the screen, which is usually what you want - set this only where one button should differ. A sound named here plays even on a screen whose buttons are otherwise silent.
ui.whatObjectSoundsLike.tip = “这个”对象被点击时的声音。留空则跟随整个界面，通常这就是你想要的——只在某个按钮需要不同的时候才设置它。这里指定的声音，即使在按钮本来静音的界面上也会响。

# Tooltip on "+ Only if…"
# en: What has to be true for this click to do anything. Failing it runs none of the actions - the button still presses, it just does nothing.
ui.addClickCondition.tip = 这次点击要生效需要满足什么。不满足时一个动作都不会执行——按钮照样按下去，只是什么也不做。

# Tooltip on "+ Action"
# en: Run one of the pack's actions when this is clicked - the same actions dialogues and rules use.
ui.addAction.tip = 点击时执行模组包的某个动作——和对话、规则使用的是同一批动作。

# Tooltip on a dropdown
# en: A TextMeshPro font asset, not a font file. The same typeface appears more than once with different outlines and shadows, and they are not interchangeable.
ui.textmeshproFontAssetNot.tip = 一个 TextMeshPro 字体资源，而不是字体文件。同一种字型会以不同的描边和阴影出现多次，它们之间不能互换。

[Docs: What a mod pack is]

# Docs: a topic's title
# en: What a mod pack is
docs.modPack.title = 什么是模组包

# Docs: the line under the topic's title
# en: The whole idea, before any of the detail.
docs.modPack.summary = 在进入细节之前，先说整体思路。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: A pack is one folder. What you make in the editor is saved in one file in it, modpack.json. Your images and sounds sit beside it, and translations go in a translations folder.
docs.modPack.packOneFolderEverything = 一个模组包就是一个文件夹。你在编辑器里做的东西保存在其中的一个文件 modpack.json 里。你的图片和声音放在它旁边，翻译放在 translations 文件夹里。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: You never edit modpack.json by hand. The editor writes it, and its tabs are the things it can hold.
docs.modPack.neverEditModpackJson = 你永远不必手动编辑 modpack.json。它由编辑器写入，而编辑器的各个选项卡就是它能容纳的内容。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Export turns the folder into one .smspack file. That is the only thing the game reads, and what you use to test. To give the pack to players, use File, then Publish for players...: it checks the pack and writes a zip that players extract into their game folder.
docs.modPack.exportTurnsFolderInto = 导出会把文件夹变成一个 .smspack 文件。游戏只读取这个文件，你测试时用的也是它。要把模组包交给玩家，请先点「文件」，再点「发布给玩家…」：它会检查模组包，并写出一个 zip，玩家把它解压到自己的游戏文件夹即可。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: The game does not know the editor exists. It reads your pack through the SMSModForge plugin, which is what actually builds your characters, rooms and conversations inside the running game.
docs.modPack.gameDoesNotKnow = 游戏并不知道编辑器的存在。它通过 SMSModForge 插件来读取你的模组包，而正是这个插件在运行中的游戏里真正构建出你的角色、房间和对话。

# Docs: a heading inside the topic
# en: Worth knowing
docs.modPack.heading.worthKnowing = 值得了解

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: A pack adds to the game rather than replacing it. Your places sit alongside the game's own, and a vanilla extension adds to a room the game already has instead of swapping it out.

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: A pack that does not appear at all is usually in the wrong place. The .smspack goes straight into the Mods folder beside the game's .exe, not into a folder inside it - make the Mods folder if it is not there. Then check the list of packs on the game's main menu: a pack can be switched off there.
docs.whenSomethingDoesNotWork.packDoesNotAppear = 完全不出现的模组包，通常是放错了位置。.smspack 要直接放进游戏 .exe 旁边的 Mods 文件夹，而不是其中的某个子文件夹——如果没有 Mods 文件夹就新建一个。然后查看游戏主菜单上的模组包列表：模组包可能在那里被关掉了。

# Docs: a point in the topic

docs.whenSomethingDoesNotWork.emptyPreviewPackHave = 预览是空的，通常说明某个文件路径不对。「验证」会列出它找不到的每个文件。

# Docs: a point in the topic

# The fold-out under a guide bullet: the rest of its explanation
# en: Take out removes one of the game's conditions from that place's script; it stays listed, struck through, with Put back beside it. The script is the room's, not the conversation's, so anything else it guards - another conversation, a quest it starts - happens without the condition too, and the Quests tab shows the same change. Where the place is (the room it belongs to) cannot be taken out here - a conversation is always played somewhere; a quest's place on the Quests tab can. A room tries its conversations in order and plays the first one that can, so the ones it says it tries first still come before this one, whatever you take out. Reset all puts these back as well.
docs.dialogues.gameChecksBeforePlays.more = 「移除」会把游戏的某个条件从那个地点的脚本里拿掉；它仍然列着，加上删除线，旁边有「放回」。脚本属于房间，而不属于对话，所以它守护的其他东西——另一段对话、它启动的任务——也会在没有这个条件的情况下发生，「任务」选项卡上也会显示同样的改动。地点的位置（它所属的房间）不能在这里移除——对话总要在某个地方播放；「任务」选项卡上任务的地点则可以。房间会按顺序尝试它的对话，并播放第一个可以播放的，所以它声明先尝试的那些对话仍然排在这一段之前，不管你移除了什么。「全部重置」也会把这些放回去。

# The fold-out under a guide bullet: the rest of its explanation
# en: Exit stops the conversation and skips everything below. Jump resumes at whichever node carries the tag you name. Once that node and the lines under it are done, the game says again any line it is under, then that line's lines - so a jump that lands under the very line that jumps goes round for ever. A node at the top level carries on cleanly, and Validate warns about the others.
docs.dialogues.wherePlayGoesAfter.more = 「退出」会结束对话并跳过下面的一切。「跳转」会从带有你所指定标签的节点处继续。等那个节点和它下面的台词结束后，游戏会再说一遍它所在的上级台词，再接着说那句台词下面的台词——所以如果跳转落在发起跳转的那句台词下面，就会无限循环。顶层的节点会顺利继续下去，其他情况「验证」会发出警告。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: On the places under Started by and Put back to not started by. Each of the game's conditions around the step is listed where it lives - a line on the way, the line itself, the place that plays the conversation, or the script.
docs.quests.placesUnderStartedPut = 用于「由以下位置开始」和「由以下位置退回未开始」下的位置。步骤周围游戏的每个条件都列在它所在的地方——沿途的一句台词、那句台词本身、播放该对话的地点，或者脚本。

# The fold-out under a guide bullet: the rest of its explanation
# en: Take out removes one from the game (struck through, with Put back); a line's condition is taken out of your version of that conversation, a place's out of its script, and either way whatever else it guards happens without it too - the Dialogues tab shows the same change. Where the script sits is a row of its own and can be taken out as well. And only if (yours) adds conditions of your own. Once you change anything at a place, that place is yours: what is left - the game's conditions you kept, the room, and yours - is asked over and over, and the quest starts (or goes back to not started) the moment it all passes, whether or not the game's own conversation or script ever gets there. Take everything out and add a key press, and the key press starts it; take the room out too and it starts anywhere. A place you have not touched behaves as the game wrote it, and putting everything back gives it back to the game. A place also says which of the room's conversations the game tries first, which decides the conversation but not your rule, and the game's log says which one the room played. A changed place is marked with a dot, and its reset arrow puts it back the way the game has it. Places that complete, count or fail a task are shown, not changed.
docs.quests.placesUnderStartedPut.more = 「移除」会把条件从游戏中拿掉（加上删除线，旁边有「放回」）；台词的条件会从你那个版本的对话中拿掉，地点的条件会从它的脚本中拿掉，不管哪种，它守护的其他东西也都会在没有它的情况下发生——「对话」选项卡上也会显示同样的改动。脚本所在的位置单独占一行，也可以移除。「并且仅当（你的）」会添加你自己的条件。一旦你在某个位置改动了任何东西，那个位置就归你了：剩下的——你保留的游戏条件、房间以及你的条件——会被反复检查，一旦全部通过，任务就会开始（或退回未开始），不管游戏自己的对话或脚本有没有走到那里。把所有条件都移除并加上一个按键，按键就会开始它；连房间也移除，它在任何地方都会开始。你没碰过的位置会按游戏写的那样运作，把一切都放回去就会把它还给游戏。位置还会说明游戏先尝试房间里的哪段对话，这决定的是播放哪段对话，而不是你的规则；游戏的运行日志会说明房间播放了哪段。改过的位置会带一个点，它的重置箭头会把它恢复成游戏原样。完成、计数或失败目标的位置只显示，不能修改。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Not every action offers every category. Switching something on or off leaves out Places, because activating a whole place is what moving between places is for.
docs.targetPicker.notEveryActionOffers = 并不是每个动作都提供全部类别。开关某样东西时不提供 Places，因为激活整个地点正是「在地点之间移动」要做的事。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: The GameObjectActive condition uses the same row, and offers the same categories switching something on and off does. Asking whether a whole place is on screen is what LevelActive is for.
docs.targetPicker.gameobjectactiveConditionUsesSame = GameObjectActive 条件使用同样的一行，提供的类别也和打开关闭东西时一样。询问整个地点是否在屏幕上，用的是 LevelActive。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Objects that start switched off are still found, so an action can turn on something that was never visible.
docs.targetPicker.objectsStartSwitchedOff = 一开始就处于关闭状态的对象同样能被找到，所以动作可以开启一个从未显示过的东西。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: A target that resolves to nothing is reported in the game's log rather than stopping anything, so a mistyped name shows up as an action that quietly does nothing.
docs.targetPicker.targetResolvesNothingReported = 指向不到任何东西的目标只会记进游戏日志，而不会中断什么，所以名字打错时表现为一个默默什么都不做的动作。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: In a condition there is no log line for it: an object that cannot be found reads the same as one switched off. Negate therefore means off or absent, not off — so a mistyped target in a negated condition passes rather than complaining.
docs.targetPicker.conditionThereNoLog = 在条件里连这条日志也没有：找不到的对象读起来和被关闭的对象一模一样。因此取反的含义是「关闭或不存在」，而不是「关闭」——于是取反条件里打错的目标会通过，而不会提出抗议。

docs.validating.warningsThingsWillRun = 警告是指能运行、但很可能不是你本意的东西——默认值无法按其类型解析、角色设为「游戏原有的立绘」却没有选择立绘、同一房间里两个 NPC 摆放同名。

docs.validating.referencesPlacesGameShips = 对游戏自带地点的引用，会按编辑器所知的版本来核对，这样在不同游戏版本之间改过名的地点就能在这里被发现，而不是留到游玩时才暴露。

# Docs: a point in the topic

docs.translations.machine = 编辑器自带的翻译由机器完成，在有人校对之前，“语言”菜单中会注明这一点。欢迎指正：用“在屏幕上编辑文字”或直接在文件中修改，然后把文件传给大家。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: What a pack stores does not change with the language: keys, names you gave things and the values conditions compare stay as you typed them.
docs.translations.storedStays = 模组包保存的内容不随语言变化：键名、你给各种东西起的名字，以及条件所比较的值，都保持你输入时的原样。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Text you put into a variable and show with [PV:...] is not translated: it is data, and a condition may be comparing it.
docs.translations.variables = 你放进变量、再用 [PV:...] 显示出来的文本不会被翻译：它是数据，而且可能正被某个条件拿来比较。

# The guide's Examples: what they assume
# en: Every example works in a pack with a character and a place of yours: the first tutorials make both. To make them now: on the Characters tab, click + Voice (a speaking part that needs no art), type a Character name such as Mia and choose her Pronouns. On the Places tab, click + Place, type a Display name such as Gallery, and under Level art give it a Back sprite and a Front sprite: 2048x1136 PNG pictures inside your pack's folder (the tutorials copy practice ones into its TutorialArt folder).
docs.example.before.s1.a = 每个示例都在一个有你自己的角色和地点的模组包里进行：前几个教程会把两者都做出来。现在就做的话：在「角色」选项卡上点「+ 语音」（一个不需要图片的说话角色），输入一个「角色名称」，比如 Mia，并选择她的「代词」。在「地点」选项卡上点「+ 地点」，输入一个「显示名称」，比如 Gallery，然后在「关卡美术」下给它一个「后景精灵图」和一个「前景精灵图」：放在你模组包文件夹里的 2048x1136 PNG 图片（教程会把练习用的图片复制到它的 TutorialArt 文件夹里）。

# The guide's Examples: what they assume
# en: "Your character" and "your place" in the steps mean those. Lists show things by their runtime name: the name without its spaces, so a track you call Gallery Jazz is GalleryJazz there.
docs.example.before.s1.b = 步骤中的“你的角色”和“你的地点”指的就是它们。列表按运行时名称显示东西：也就是去掉空格的名字，所以你叫 Gallery Jazz 的曲目在那里是 GalleryJazz。

# The title of an example in the guide
# en: A greeting once a day
docs.example.onceADay.title = 每天一次的问候

# An example's summary: what it makes and which tabs it uses
# en: A line a character says the first time the player comes by each day, and not again until the next. Tabs: Variables, Dialogues.
docs.example.onceADay.summary = 角色在玩家每天第一次来时说的一句台词，直到第二天才会再说。选项卡：「变量」「对话」。

# A step's heading in a guide example, numbered
# en: 1. A variable that resets every morning
docs.example.onceADay.s1 = 1. 每天早上重置的变量

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: On the Variables tab, click + Variable. Name it GreetedToday, set Type to Bool and pick Starts false. Set Refresh mode to Daily, and tick Persisted so the save keeps it.
docs.example.onceADay.s1.do = 在「变量」选项卡上点「+ 变量」。把它命名为 GreetedToday，「类型」设为 Bool，并选择「初始为假」。把「刷新模式」设为 Daily，并勾选「持久化」，让存档记住它。

# A step of a guide example: why, or what it means
# en: Daily puts it back to false at the start of every in-game day, so the greeting is ready again each morning. Without Persisted, loading a save would bring it back the same day.
docs.example.onceADay.s1.why = Daily 会在每个游戏日开始时把它重置为假，所以每天早上问候都会重新就绪。没有「持久化」的话，加载存档会让它在同一天里又回到初始状态。

# A step's heading in a guide example, numbered
# en: 2. A conversation that waits for it
docs.example.onceADay.s2 = 2. 等待它的对话

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: On the Dialogues tab, click + Dialogue and name it "Morning hello". Under Start conditions, the first row reads Required — this dialogue only starts in this level: choose your place in it. Then click + Add condition: Variable, GreetedToday, equals, false.
docs.example.onceADay.s2.do = 在「对话」选项卡上点「+ 对话」，并把它命名为「Morning hello」。在「开始条件」下，第一行写着「必需 —— 这段对话只在这个关卡开始」：在里面选择你的地点。然后点「+ 添加条件」：Variable、GreetedToday、「等于」、「假」。

# A step's heading in a guide example, numbered
# en: 3. What she says
docs.example.onceADay.s3 = 3. 她说什么

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: Click + New Node. Choose your character as the Actor and write the Text: "Good morning! You're early today."
docs.example.onceADay.s3.do = 点「+ 新节点」。选你的角色作为「演员」，并写下「文本」：「Good morning! You're early today.」

# A step's heading in a guide example, numbered
# en: 4. Remember it for today
docs.example.onceADay.s4 = 4. 记住今天

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: With that line chosen, add an action under Actions on finish: Variable, Set, GreetedToday, true.
docs.example.onceADay.s4.do = 选中那句台词，在「结束时的动作」下添加一个动作：Variable、「设置」、GreetedToday、「真」。

# A step of a guide example: why, or what it means
# en: Once the line has played, the start condition no longer passes - until Daily resets the variable tomorrow.
docs.example.onceADay.s4.why = 台词播放过后，开始条件就不再通过——直到明天 Daily 重置这个变量。

# The title of an example in the guide
# en: A choice she remembers
docs.example.rememberedChoice.title = 她记得的选择

# An example's summary: what it makes and which tabs it uses
# en: A question with two answers, and a line that only plays for one of them. Tabs: Variables, Dialogues.
docs.example.rememberedChoice.summary = 一个有两个回答的问题，以及一句只对其中一个回答播放的台词。选项卡：「变量」「对话」。

# A step's heading in a guide example, numbered
# en: 1. A variable for the answer
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s1 = 1. 存放回答的变量

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: On the Variables tab, click + Variable, name it LikesJazz, set Type to Bool, pick Starts false and tick Persisted.
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s1.do = 在「变量」选项卡上点「+ 变量」，命名为 LikesJazz，「类型」设为 Bool，选择「初始为假」并勾选「持久化」。

# A step's heading in a guide example, numbered
# en: 2. The question
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s2 = 2. 问题

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: Make a conversation "Music taste" for your place, as in A greeting once a day, step 2 (without the GreetedToday condition). Click + New Node, set Kind to Choice, choose your character as the Actor and write "Do you like jazz?". Click + Child and write "Love it."; then, with that answer chosen, click + Sibling and write "Not really."
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s2.do = 为你的地点做一段对话「Music taste」，做法同「每天一次的问候」的第 2 步（不加 GreetedToday 条件）。点「+ 新节点」，把「类型」设为「选择」，选你的角色作为「演员」，并写下「Do you like jazz?」。点「+ 子节点」并写下「Love it.」；然后选中这个回答，点「+ 同级」并写下「Not really.」。

# A step of a guide example: why, or what it means
# en: A Choice line offers the lines under it to the player as answers. + Child adds a line under the chosen one, + Sibling one beside it.
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s2.why = 「选择」台词会把它下面的台词作为回答提供给玩家。「+ 子节点」在选中的台词下面添加一句，「+ 同级」在它旁边添加一句。

# A step's heading in a guide example, numbered
# en: 3. Keep the answer
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s3 = 3. 记住回答

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: Choose "Love it." and add an action under Actions on finish: Variable, Set, LikesJazz, true.
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s3.do = 选中「Love it.」，在「结束时的动作」下添加一个动作：Variable、「设置」、LikesJazz、「真」。

# A step's heading in a guide example, numbered
# en: 4. Use it later
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s4 = 4. 之后再用它

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: Choose the question and click + Sibling for a line after it: "I'll put some jazz on for you." Under Conditions, add Variable, LikesJazz, equals, true.
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s4.do = 选中问题，点「+ 同级」，在它后面加一句台词：「I'll put some jazz on for you.」。在「条件」下添加 Variable、LikesJazz、「等于」、「真」。

# A step of a guide example: why, or what it means
# en: A line whose conditions do not pass is skipped, so only players who said yes hear it - here or in any later conversation.
docs.example.rememberedChoice.s4.why = 条件不通过的台词会被跳过，所以只有回答“是”的玩家才会听到——在这里，或之后的任何对话中。

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: Make a conversation "Weather talk" for your place, as in A greeting once a day, step 2. Click + New Node, choose your character and write "Did you get caught in the rain?". Under Conditions, add Weather, Weather is Raining.

# en: 2. And one for every other day
docs.example.rainyLine.s2 = 2. 再加一句给其他日子

docs.example.rainyLine.s2.do = 点「+ 同级」并写下「What a lovely day.」。添加同样的条件 Weather、「下雨」，并勾选它的「取反」。

# A step of a guide example: why, or what it means
# en: Negate turns a condition's answer around, so exactly one of the two lines plays.
docs.example.rainyLine.s2.why = 「取反」会把条件的结果反过来，所以两句台词中正好有一句播放。

docs.example.countVisits.s1 = 1. 计数器

# A step of a guide example: what to do

# A step of a guide example: what to do
# en: On the Integration tab, click + Rule, name it "Count visits" and set Trigger mode to OnRisingEdge. Add the condition LevelActive, Level your place, and the action Variable, Increment, Visits, Delta 1.
docs.example.countVisits.s2.do = 在「集成」选项卡上点「+ 规则」，命名为「Count visits」，并把「触发模式」设为 OnRisingEdge。添加条件 LevelActive，「关卡」选你的地点，以及动作 Variable、「增加」、Visits、「增量」1。

# A step of a guide example: why, or what it means
# en: OnRisingEdge fires once each time its conditions become true: once per arrival, not again and again while the player stays.
docs.example.countVisits.s2.why = OnRisingEdge 在条件每次变为真时触发一次：每次到达触发一次，而不是在玩家停留期间反复触发。

# The fold-out under a guide bullet: the rest of its explanation
# en: The key is the character's dialogue key. Write the token rather than the name, and the line follows a rename, yours or another pack's. Validate lists the game's characters named in plain text, and a token whose key is nobody's.
docs.puttingValuesIntoText.nameToken.more = 键是角色的对话键名。写标记而不是名字，台词就会跟随改名，无论是你改的还是其他模组包改的。「验证」会列出以普通文字写出的游戏角色名字，以及键不属于任何角色的标记。

docs.places.children.more = 子对象随父对象一起打开和关闭，父对象上的「激活条件」或 RandomChildActivator 会替它们所有一起决定。它的位置不跟随父对象：你的对象站在房间里它自己的 X 和 Y 上，所以要给每个子对象设置自己的位置。（绑定到游戏某个对象的子对象，或者某个对象的副本，会像游戏那样相对于父对象放置。）

tutorial.firstSteps.willEndUp.body = 市中心一间空荡荡的画廊里站着一个人体模特——Dummy。没人看的时候她会动，她梦想成为一名 Starmaker 模特。每个教程都会把她故事的一部分加进同一个模组。这一个：模组包，以及她。

# The fold-out under a tutorial step: the whole explanation
# en: Everything here is real work, not a demo: after each tutorial the pack loads in the game. Each tutorial can also be followed on its own - one that needs what an earlier one made offers to bring it in.\n\nDrag this box out of the way whenever it covers something. The list at its top right goes to any step; Do it for me does a step for you, and Ctrl+Z takes back whatever was done.
tutorial.firstSteps.willEndUp.more = 这里的一切都是真正的工作，不是演示：每个教程结束后，模组包都能在游戏里加载。每个教程也可以单独跟着做——需要前面教程成果的教程会提出帮你导入。\n\n这个框挡住东西时，随时可以把它拖开。它右上角的列表可以跳到任意一步；「帮我完成」会替你完成一步，Ctrl+Z 可以撤销已做的任何操作。

# The fold-out under a tutorial step: the whole explanation
# en: A pack owns its whole folder: everything in it goes into the file players install, so give it a folder of its own - not your Desktop or Documents. If the folder you choose already holds something, ModForge makes a folder named after the pack inside it, and says so before you press Create.
tutorial.firstSteps.startFreshPack.more = 模组包拥有它的整个文件夹：里面的一切都会进入玩家安装的文件，所以给它一个单独的文件夹——不要用桌面或「文档」。如果你选择的文件夹里已经有东西，ModForge 会在里面建一个以模组包命名的文件夹，并在你按「创建」之前告诉你。

# The fold-out under a tutorial step: the whole explanation

tutorial.firstSteps.someArtWork.more = 这些文件现在归你了——可以修改、替换，用完后也可以删掉这个文件夹。每个用到图片的步骤都会说明它是什么样的图片，所以同样的步骤也适用于你自己的图片。

# The fold-out under a tutorial step: the whole explanation
# en: A bust is the picture of a character from the chest up, shown while she talks. The game's are 256 x 256 pixels; art of another size is scaled to fit, so drawing at that size looks sharpest.\n\nBust1 to Bust5 are the same Dummy, growing curvier and surer of herself as the story goes on. The other files in each folder - Blink, Mouth, Expression - give her a moving face in a later tutorial.
tutorial.firstSteps.giveThemFace.more = 立绘是角色从胸部往上的图片，在她说话时显示。游戏的立绘是 256 x 256 像素；其他尺寸的图片会缩放到合适大小，所以按这个尺寸绘制最清晰。\n\nBust1 到 Bust5 都是同一个 Dummy，随着故事推进，她越来越丰满、越来越自信。每个文件夹里的其他文件——Blink、Mouth、Expression——会在后面的教程里让她的脸动起来。

# The fold-out under a tutorial step: the whole explanation
# en: The three boxes tell the game which pictures to look for besides the bust: a blink, four mouths that move while she talks, four expressions. A ticked box with no picture behind it is a broken outfit, and the game leaves the whole character out without a word - so they say only what is there.
tutorial.firstSteps.sayOutfitHas.more = 这三个框告诉游戏除了立绘之外还要找哪些图片：一张眨眼图、她说话时变化的四张嘴型图、四张表情图。勾选了却没有对应图片的框会让服装损坏，游戏会一声不响地把整个角色去掉——所以只勾选确实有的。

# The fold-out under a tutorial step: the whole explanation
# en: ModForge's setup put its plugin into the game folder you chose; that plugin is what reads your pack. The game loads every .smspack in Mods, the folder beside its .exe - make it if it isn't there. Export remembers the place, and changes nothing in the pack itself, so use it as often as you like. The game reads the pack again each time a save is loaded: with the game already running, go back to the main menu and load a save.\n\nFile, then Publish for players, is for giving the pack to others. It checks the pack first, then writes a zip with the pack already in a Mods folder: they extract it into their game folder and are done.
tutorial.firstSteps.pack.more = ModForge 的安装程序把它的插件放进了你选择的游戏文件夹；读取你的模组包的就是这个插件。游戏会加载 Mods 里的每个 .smspack，Mods 就是它 .exe 旁边的文件夹——如果没有就新建一个。导出会记住这个位置，而且不会改变模组包本身，所以想导出多少次都可以。游戏每次加载存档时都会重新读取模组包：如果游戏已经在运行，就回到主菜单再加载一个存档。\n\n先点「文件」，再点「发布给玩家…」，用于把模组包交给别人。它会先检查模组包，然后写出一个 zip，里面的模组包已经放在 Mods 文件夹中：他们把它解压到自己的游戏文件夹就完成了。

# The fold-out under a tutorial step: the whole explanation
# en: Translations are made from it, and players whose language has no translation read the pack in it. Export and Publish offer to translate by machine what is not translated yet; to read or correct a translation, choose its language under Editing in, at the right end of the tabs.\n\nThe version under the pack's name moves only when you publish: something new moves the middle number, a change to something already there moves the last.
tutorial.firstSteps.writtenIn.more = 翻译以它为基础，语言没有翻译的玩家会以它阅读模组包。导出和发布会提议用机器翻译尚未翻译的内容；要阅读或更正某个翻译，在选项卡右端的「编辑语言」下选择它的语言。\n\n模组包名字下面的版本只在你发布时才会变：新增的东西会让中间的数字变化，对已有东西的修改会让最后一个数字变化。

# The fold-out under a tutorial step: the whole explanation

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: Actions are what happens: a variable changes, an object appears, music starts, a screen opens. They run from the top of the list down, all in the same moment unless a Wait sits between them. A choice the player picks runs its actions as it is picked. The same actions - the same Type list - are offered everywhere something can happen: lines, integration rules, a place's arrival and leaving, a screen's buttons. Learn them once here.
tutorial.deeperActions.story.more = 动作就是发生的事情：变量改变、对象出现、音乐响起、界面打开。它们从列表顶部往下运行，除非中间夹着一个 Wait，否则都在同一时刻发生。玩家选中的选项会在被选中时运行它的动作。凡是能发生事情的地方都提供同样的动作——同样的「类型」列表：台词、集成规则、地点的到达和离开、界面上的按钮。在这里学一次就够了。

tutorial.deeperRules.story.title = 规则自行运作

# Tutorial step: what to do, in a sentence or two
# en: A rule checks its conditions by itself and fires its actions - nobody has to talk or click: as the game runs, or at the moments its Trigger mode names. It is how a pack changes the world on its own.
tutorial.deeperRules.story.body = 规则会自行检查条件并触发动作——不需要任何人对话或点击：在游戏运行时，或在它的「触发模式」所指定的时刻。模组包就是靠它自己改变世界的。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: Each rule has a Trigger mode (when it fires), Conditions (what must be true) and Actions (what it does), and can have else-if branches and a Repeat for each. The rule you made in tutorial 15, Rules that run themselves, shows her pose with OnRisingEdge: once, the moment its conditions turn true.
tutorial.deeperRules.story.more = 每条规则都有「触发模式」（何时触发）、「条件」（什么必须成立）和「动作」（做什么），还可以有“否则如果”分支和「逐项重复」。你在教程 15「自己运行的规则」中做的规则用 OnRisingEdge 显示她的姿势：在条件变为成立的那一刻触发一次。

# Tutorial step title
# en: Some nights
tutorial.deeperRules.nightly.title = 有些夜晚

# Tutorial step: what to do, in a sentence or two
# en: Click + Rule - a new, empty rule opens - name it "Some nights" and set Trigger mode to OnDayChange.
tutorial.deeperRules.nightly.body = 点击 + 规则——会打开一条新的空规则——命名为「Some nights」，并把「触发模式」设为 OnDayChange。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: OnDayChange fires once each time a new day starts in the game, after the player sleeps. It is how a pack lets time pass: a cooldown ends, a list is rebuilt, a mood fades.
tutorial.deeperRules.nightly.more = OnDayChange 在游戏里每开始新的一天（玩家睡觉之后）触发一次。模组包就是这样让时间流逝的：冷却结束、列表重建、心情淡去。

# Tutorial step: where to click, when the step waits
# en: + Rule is above the list of rules. Trigger mode is in the rule's first box.
tutorial.deeperRules.nightly.hint = + 规则在规则列表上方。「触发模式」在规则的第一个框里。

# Tutorial step title
# en: She loses a little nerve
tutorial.deeperRules.nightlyWhat.title = 她泄了点气

# Tutorial step: what to do, in a sentence or two
# en: Give the rule two conditions - Variable Confidence greater than 1, and DailyChance with Chance 25 - and an action: Type Variable, Operation Increment, Name Confidence, Delta -1.
tutorial.deeperRules.nightlyWhat.body = 给这条规则两个条件——Variable，Confidence 大于 1；以及 DailyChance，「概率」25——再加一个动作：「类型」Variable，「操作」增加，「名称」Confidence，「增量」-1。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: One night in four she loses a little nerve, but never below 1. Each goodbye raises it by one (the Actions chapter), so she grows surer of herself - just not in a straight line. The conditions of an OnDayChange rule are checked at the moment the day changes.
tutorial.deeperRules.nightlyWhat.more = 每四个夜晚中有一个她会泄点气，但绝不会低于 1。每次道别会让它加一（见「动作」那一章），所以她会越来越自信——只是不会直线上升。OnDayChange 规则的条件在日子切换的那一刻检查。

# Tutorial step: where to click, when the step waits
# en: The rule is chosen. + Add condition and + Add action are at the bottom of their boxes.
tutorial.deeperRules.nightlyWhat.hint = 规则已被选中。+ 添加条件和 + 添加动作在各自框的底部。

# Tutorial step title
# en: When a rule fires
tutorial.deeperRules.modes.title = 规则何时触发

# Tutorial step: what to do, in a sentence or two
# en: OnRisingEdge: once, when its conditions become true. OnFallingEdge: once, when they stop. WhilePassing: every moment they hold. OnSceneLoad and OnDayChange: once for each load, or each new day.
tutorial.deeperRules.modes.body = OnRisingEdge：条件变为成立时触发一次。OnFallingEdge：条件不再成立时触发一次。WhilePassing：条件成立期间每时每刻都触发。OnSceneLoad 和 OnDayChange：每次加载或每个新的一天触发一次。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: Most rules want OnRisingEdge: "when this becomes true, do that, once" - it fires again only after its conditions have been false in between. WhilePassing runs its actions about 60 times a second: fine for keeping one value in step with another, wrong for adding to a number. OnSceneLoad fires each time the game's world loads, a good moment to set things up.
tutorial.deeperRules.modes.more = 大多数规则用 OnRisingEdge 就对了：“当这件事成立时，做那件事，一次”——只有条件中间变为不成立过，它才会再次触发。WhilePassing 每秒大约运行 60 次动作：适合让一个值与另一个值保持同步，不适合给数字累加。OnSceneLoad 在游戏世界每次加载时触发，是做初始设置的好时机。

# Tutorial step title
# en: A word for her mood
tutorial.deeperRules.moodVariable.title = 用一个词表示她的心情

# Tutorial step: what to do, in a sentence or two
# en: On the Variables tab, click + Variable. Name it "Mood", set Type to String and Default value to Shy.
tutorial.deeperRules.moodVariable.body = 在「变量」选项卡上点击 + 变量。命名为「Mood」，「类型」设为 String，「默认值」设为 Shy。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: A String variable holds words. Her mood will be Shy, Brave or Bold, and a line can say it: "I'm feeling [PV:Mood] today."
tutorial.deeperRules.moodVariable.more = String 变量存的是文字。她的心情会是 Shy、Brave 或 Bold，台词也可以说出来：「I'm feeling [PV:Mood] today.」

# Tutorial step: where to click, when the step waits
# en: + Variable is above the list; Type and Default value are in the box on the right.
tutorial.deeperRules.moodVariable.hint = + 变量在列表上方；「类型」和「默认值」在右边的框里。

# Tutorial step title
# en: Her mood, in one rule
tutorial.deeperRules.branches.title = 一条规则决定她的心情

# Tutorial step: what to do, in a sentence or two
# en: Click + Rule - a new, empty rule opens - and name it "Her mood" (its Trigger mode stays OnRisingEdge). Condition: Variable Confidence greater or equal 6; action: Variable, Operation Set, Name Mood, Value Bold. Then click + Add else-if branch twice: the first with Confidence greater or equal 3, setting Brave; the second with no condition, setting Shy.
tutorial.deeperRules.branches.body = 点击 + 规则——会打开一条新的空规则——命名为「Her mood」（「触发模式」保持 OnRisingEdge）。条件：Variable，Confidence 大于或等于 6；动作：Variable，「操作」设置，「名称」Mood，「值」Bold。然后点击两次 + 添加“否则如果”分支：第一个条件为 Confidence 大于或等于 3，设置为 Brave；第二个不加条件，设置为 Shy。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: Branches are tried from the top, only when everything above them failed, and the first that passes wins. A branch with no conditions always passes: it is the "else". OnRisingEdge fires each time the winning branch changes, so Mood follows her confidence up and down. Without branches this takes three rules that must be kept from overlapping.
tutorial.deeperRules.branches.more = 分支从上往下尝试，只有上面的全都失败时才会轮到它，第一个通过的分支胜出。没有条件的分支总会通过：它就是“否则”。每当胜出的分支改变，OnRisingEdge 都会触发，所以 Mood 会随她的自信上下变化。没有分支的话，这需要三条规则，还得小心不让它们相互重叠。

# Tutorial step: where to click, when the step waits
# en: + Rule is above the list of rules. + Add else-if branch is in the rule's last box; each branch has its own + buttons.
tutorial.deeperRules.branches.hint = + 规则在规则列表上方。+ 添加“否则如果”分支在规则的最后一个框里；每个分支都有自己的 + 按钮。

# Tutorial step title
# en: Hearts in the air
tutorial.deeperRules.timer.title = 空中的爱心

# Tutorial step: what to do, in a sentence or two
# en: Click + Rule - a new, empty rule opens - and name it "Hearts in the air". Conditions: LevelActive with Level The Gallery, and Timer with Wait (s) 30. Action: PlayEffect, Effect HeartsForHer ("Hearts for her").
tutorial.deeperRules.timer.body = 点击 + 规则——会打开一条新的空规则——命名为「Hearts in the air」。条件：LevelActive，「关卡」The Gallery；以及 Timer，「等待（秒）」30。动作：PlayEffect，「特效」HeartsForHer（「Hearts for her」）。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: A Timer passes once its wait has gone by since the rule last fired, then starts again. With LevelActive, hearts float up every 30 seconds while the player is in her gallery, and the rule waits while they are elsewhere. Randomize picks a new wait each time, between Min (s) and Max (s); Stagger start waits a whole interval before the first time. Timers are offered in rules only.
tutorial.deeperRules.timer.more = 自规则上次触发以来经过了设定的等待时间，Timer 就会通过一次，然后重新计时。配合 LevelActive，玩家在她画廊里时，每 30 秒就会飘起一次爱心；玩家在别处时，规则就等着。「随机」每次在「最小（秒）」和「最大（秒）」之间挑一个新的等待时间；「错开开始」会在第一次之前先等一个完整的间隔。计时器只在规则里提供。

# Tutorial step: where to click, when the step waits
# en: + Rule above the list, then + Add condition twice at the bottom of its Conditions box.
tutorial.deeperRules.timer.hint = 列表上方的 + 规则，然后在它「条件」框底部点两次 + 添加条件。

# Tutorial step title
# en: One rule for both
tutorial.deeperRules.forEach.title = 一条规则管两个

# Tutorial step: what to do, in a sentence or two
# en: Click + Rule - a new, empty rule opens - and name it "Hide the others", Trigger mode OnSceneLoad. Under Repeat for each, For each value in: MannequinLeft,MannequinRight and Placeholder name: m. Condition: KeptHerSecret equals false. Action: SetGameObjectActive, Category NPCs, Level The Gallery, NPC {m}, Switch Deactivate.
tutorial.deeperRules.forEach.body = 点击 + 规则——会打开一条新的空规则——命名为「Hide the others」，「触发模式」OnSceneLoad。在「逐项重复」下，「遍历以下各值」：MannequinLeft,MannequinRight，「占位符名称」：m。条件：KeptHerSecret 等于「假」。动作：SetGameObjectActive，「类别」NPC，「关卡」The Gallery，「NPC」{m}，「开关」停用。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: MannequinLeft and MannequinRight are the two mannequins you placed in her gallery in tutorial 11, A row of mannequins. The rule runs once for each value, with {m} replaced by it: one rule instead of one per mannequin. Until you promise to keep her secret, they are hidden each time the world loads - she is shy of company. The values can come from a List variable too: $PosesSeen repeats over whatever it holds.
tutorial.deeperRules.forEach.more = MannequinLeft 和 MannequinRight 是你在教程 11「一排人体模特」中摆进她画廊的两个人体模特。规则会对每个值各运行一次，并把 {m} 替换成那个值：一条规则，而不是每个人体模特一条。在你答应保守她的秘密之前，每次世界加载时它们都会被隐藏——她怕生。这些值也可以来自一个 List 变量：$PosesSeen 会对它里面的所有内容逐项重复。

# Tutorial step: where to click, when the step waits
# en: Repeat for each is the box under the rule's first box. Type {m} into the NPC box.
tutorial.deeperRules.forEach.hint = 「逐项重复」是规则第一个框下面的那个框。在「NPC」框里输入 {m}。

# Tutorial step title
# en: Rules you can see into
tutorial.deeperRules.tools.title = 看得透的规则

# Tutorial step: what to do, in a sentence or two
# en: Set for condition debugging writes what a rule decides to the game's log. Code mode shows the whole rule as text you can copy, paste or share.
tutorial.deeperRules.tools.body = 「设为条件调试」会把规则的决定写进游戏日志。「代码模式」把整条规则显示为文本，可以复制、粘贴或分享。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more
# en: With debugging ticked, BepInEx's console and its LogOutput.log get a line each time the rule's decision changes, with every condition's value when nothing passed. Code mode and the rows are the same rule, so switch back and forth freely. Copy all and Paste move conditions and actions between rules, lines and places.
tutorial.deeperRules.tools.more = 勾选调试后，每当规则的决定改变，BepInEx 的控制台及其 LogOutput.log 就会多一行记录，都没通过时还会附上每个条件的值。「代码模式」和逐行视图是同一条规则，可以随意来回切换。「全部复制」和「粘贴」能在规则、台词和地点之间搬运条件和动作。

# Tutorial step: the whole explanation, under Tell me more

# A tutorial step's fold-out: the rest of its explanation
# en: WhilePassing acts again and again for as long as its conditions hold - many times a second. Right for keeping a value inside its limits: the moment Confidence goes over 10, it is put back. For anything that adds up, it would add many times a second; use OnRisingEdge.
tutorial.deeperWatching.whilePassing.more = 只要条件成立，WhilePassing 就会一遍又一遍地执行——每秒很多次。它适合把一个值保持在范围之内：Confidence 一超过 10，就会被放回去。对于会累加的东西，它每秒会加很多次；那种情况请用 OnRisingEdge。

# en: Rainy days

# A tutorial step's instruction (short)

tutorial.deeperWatching.weather.more = Weather 条件询问的是游戏里的天气：「下雨」、「下雪」，或两者皆可的「恶劣天气」。默认的 OnRisingEdge 会在每次开始下雨时设置一次她的心情。「Her mood」规则只在她的自信跨入另一个档位时才会重新设置心情，所以雨停之后她可能还会害羞一阵子。

# A tutorial step's title
# en: In and out
tutorial.deeperRooms.fades.title = 淡入与淡出

# A tutorial step's instruction (short)
# en: Scroll down to her Poster and give it the component FadeInSprite. Then add FadeOutSprite to the Visitor's placement, with Delay 20, Duration 2 and Deactivate on complete ticked - and, on that placement itself, untick Switch back off when the conditions stop matching.
tutorial.deeperRooms.fades.body = 向下滚动到她的 Poster，给它加上组件 FadeInSprite。然后给 Visitor 的摆放加上 FadeOutSprite，「延迟」20，「时长」2，勾选「完成后停用」——并在那个摆放本身上取消勾选「条件不再满足时重新关闭」。

# A tutorial step's fold-out: the rest of its explanation
# en: FadeInSprite fades an object in each time it is switched on, so her poster appears softly. FadeOutSprite fades one out after a delay; with Deactivate on complete, it is switched off once gone - the visitor stays a while, then leaves. Switch back off is unticked because, ticked, Active when puts its answer back every moment, and would switch her straight on again. Unticked, she also stays if the Dummy's confidence falls below 5 again (tutorial 23): the fade-out is what sends her away now.
tutorial.deeperRooms.fades.more = FadeInSprite 在对象每次被开启时让它淡入，所以她的海报会柔和地出现。FadeOutSprite 在一段延迟之后让对象淡出；勾选「完成后停用」时，对象消失后就会被关闭——访客待一会儿，然后离开。之所以取消勾选「条件不再满足时重新关闭」，是因为勾选时，「激活条件」每时每刻都会把它的答案放回去，会立刻又把她打开。取消勾选后，即使 Dummy 的自信再次跌到 5 以下（教程 23），她也会留下：现在让她离开的是淡出。

tutorial.deeperRooms.fades.hint = NPC 的摆放也可以加组件，在它自己的面板下方。

# Guide bullet

# Guide: a box's heading
# en: Objects
docs.ui.tree.term = 对象

# Guide bullet
# en: Everything a screen holds, one object inside another. + Object adds an empty one inside what is chosen, + Piece a ready-made button, row or label, + Shape a whole window, dialog or list.
docs.ui.tree = 界面里的一切，一个对象套着另一个。「+ 对象」在选中的对象里添加一个空对象，「+ 部件」添加现成的按钮、行或标签，「+ 形状」添加一整个窗口、对话框或列表。

# Guide bullet: the rest, folded away
# en: + From game copies part of one of the game's screens in as yours to change; the original is untouched. Copy and Paste (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V) move objects, with what they hold, between screens.
docs.ui.tree.more = 「+ 来自游戏」把游戏某个界面的一部分复制进来，作为你可以修改的内容；原件不会被改动。「复制」和「粘贴」（Ctrl+C、Ctrl+V）可以在界面之间移动对象，连同它们包含的内容。

# Guide: a box's heading
# en: Preview
docs.ui.preview.term = 预览

# Guide bullet
# en: The screen at the game's own size. Click an object to choose it, drag it to move it, or drag its handles to resize it.
docs.ui.preview = 按游戏自身尺寸显示的界面。点击对象来选中它，拖动来移动它，或者拖动它的手柄来调整大小。

# Guide: a section of the UI tab
# en: Where it sits
docs.ui.where.term = 位置

# Guide bullet
# en: Stick to keeps it with a side or a corner of its parent; X and Y move it from there, and Width and Height size it. Fill the width or Fill the height stretches it across its parent instead.
docs.ui.where = 「贴靠」让它贴在父对象的某条边或某个角上；「X」和「Y」从那里移动它，「宽度」和「高度」决定它的大小。「填满宽度」或「填满高度」则让它横跨父对象伸展。

# Guide bullet: the rest, folded away
# en: Exact anchors and pivot shows the numbers the game itself uses, for when the simple choices are not enough. An object inside one that arranges what it holds is placed by its parent, and says so.
docs.ui.where.more = 「精确的锚点和轴心」会显示游戏自己使用的数字，用于简单选项不够用的时候。放在一个会排列内部内容的对象里的对象，由父对象来摆放，并会注明这一点。

# Guide: a section of the UI tab
# en: How it looks
docs.ui.looks.term = 外观

# Guide bullet
# en: A picture (Sprite, Tint, Drawn as), words (Text, Font, Size, Alignment) or both. Opacity fades the object and everything inside it.
docs.ui.looks = 一张图片（「精灵图」、「着色」、「绘制方式」）、文字（「文本」、「字体」、「大小」、「对齐」），或者两者都有。「不透明度」会让对象及其内部的一切变淡。

# Guide bullet: the rest, folded away
# en: Drawn as Sliced keeps a picture's corners as it stretches - the way to make one frame fit any size. Shrink to fit makes words as large as fits, between two sizes. The game draws no shadow or outline on words; a font that has them built in does.
docs.ui.looks.more = 「绘制方式」选 Sliced 时，图片拉伸时会保留四角——这是让一个边框适应任意大小的办法。「缩小以适应」会让文字在两个大小之间尽可能大。游戏不会给文字画阴影或描边；字体自带阴影或描边时才会有。

# Guide: a section of the UI tab
# en: What's inside
docs.ui.inside.term = 里面有什么

# Guide bullet
# en: Arrange lines up what an object holds - in a row, a column or a grid - with Spacing between them and Padding around, so the objects inside need no places of their own.
docs.ui.inside = 「排列方式」把对象里的内容排列整齐——排成一行、一列或网格——中间有「间距」，周围有「内边距」，这样里面的对象就不需要各自的位置。

# Guide: a section of the UI tab
# en: What clicking does
docs.ui.clicks.term = 点击后做什么

# Guide bullet
# en: + Action: what a click runs - the same actions as a line's, so a button can set a variable, open another screen or start a conversation. + Only if... makes the click do nothing while its conditions fail.
docs.ui.clicks = 「+ 动作」：点击时执行什么——和台词上的动作一样，所以按钮可以设置变量、打开另一个界面或开始一段对话。「+ 仅当…」让点击在它的条件不成立时什么都不做。

# Guide bullet: the rest, folded away
# en: Pressed shrinks it a little while it is held down, as the game's buttons do. Hover is how it looks while the pointer is over it.
docs.ui.clicks.more = 「按下时」让它在被按住时稍微缩小一点，就像游戏的按钮那样。「悬停」是指针停在它上面时的样子。

# Guide: a section of the UI tab
# en: When it shows
docs.ui.shows.term = 何时显示

# Guide bullet
# en: With no conditions an object is simply shown. + Condition hides it while they fail; they are checked all the time, so it comes and goes as they change.
docs.ui.shows = 没有条件时，对象就直接显示。「+ 条件」会在条件不成立时隐藏它；条件一直在被检查，所以它会随着条件的变化出现和消失。

# Guide: a section of the UI tab
# en: How it moves
docs.ui.moves.term = 如何运动

# Guide bullet
# en: Keeps moving: a pulse of its size or its fade, or a sweep from one place to another, a pass every so many Seconds, with a Delay before the first and a Pause between.
docs.ui.moves = 「持续运动」：大小或淡化程度的脉动，或者从一处到另一处的扫动，每隔若干「秒数」一轮，第一轮之前有「延迟」，两轮之间有「停顿」。

[Pack translations: translating by machine]

# Said against one line that came back damaged. The line is not written and the
# pack's own words are kept, so these explain why a line was left alone.
# en: The translation came back without {codes}.
packText.mt.lostCodes = 翻译回来时少了 {codes}。

# The braces, tags and tokens are named without writing any of them out, since
# writing one here would make it a gap in this text rather than words about one.
# en: The translation does not carry the same words in braces, tags and tokens as the original.
packText.mt.differentCodes = 译文没有保留原文里同样的花括号词语、标签和记号。

# en: The translation came back empty.
packText.mt.empty = 翻译回来是空的。

# Said when a whole run stops. Each explains what to do next, because stopping
# is not a failure: everything already translated is kept.
# en: The translation service sent back a different number of lines from the number it was given, so nothing in that batch could be matched up to the text it came from.
packText.mt.miscounted = 翻译服务返回的行数和发出去的不一样，所以那一批里没有一条能对上它原本的文本。

# en: The translation service refused the request ({status}): {why}

vhint.TowerDefense.health = 你在面包店小游戏中的生命值：开始时为 20，每有一个敌人突破就 -1，Life 卡和 Shaman Mini 会让它增加。降到 0 时你失败，什么也得不到。

# TowerDefense[timer]
# en: The countdown shown on screen during a bakery-minigame round: 60 at each round's start, down 1 a second. The round ends after a fixed wait, not at 0.
vhint.TowerDefense.timer = 面包店小游戏一轮中屏幕上显示的倒计时：每轮开始时为 60，每秒减 1。一轮在固定的等待后结束，而不是在 0 时结束。

# TowerDefense[Energy]
# en: Your gold in the bakery minigame, spent to place Minis (10-70 each): 25 at the start, +1 per enemy defeated, +5/20/50 from Gold cards between rounds.
vhint.TowerDefense.Energy = 你在面包店小游戏中的金币，用来放置 Minis（每个 10-70）：开始时为 25，每击败一个敌人 +1，轮与轮之间的 Gold 卡 +5/20/50。

# TowerDefense[tdmoneyinc]
# en: Cash the bakery minigame will pay: each round you start adds its reward (Easy $100, Medium $250, Hard $500). Paid if you survive every round; lost at 0 life.
vhint.TowerDefense.tdmoneyinc = 面包店小游戏将支付的现金：你开始的每一轮都会加上它的奖励（Easy $100、Medium $250、Hard $500）。挺过所有轮次即可获得；生命降到 0 则失去。

# TowerDefense[towercombatactive]
# en: True while a bakery-minigame round is being fought; false between rounds and after the minigame ends. The Shaman Mini heals you only while it is true.
vhint.TowerDefense.towercombatactive = 面包店小游戏的一轮战斗进行期间为真；轮与轮之间以及小游戏结束后为假。Shaman Mini 只在它为真时为你治疗。

# TowerDefense[currentround]
# en: Bakery-minigame rounds finished: 0 at the start, +1 as each round ends. After rounds 1, 2 and 4 enemies spawn more often (interval 4, then 3, 2, 1).
vhint.TowerDefense.currentround = 面包店小游戏已完成的轮数：开始时为 0，每轮结束时 +1。第 1、2、4 轮之后敌人出现得更频繁（间隔 4，然后 3、2、1）。

# TowerDefense[roundsremaining]
# en: Rounds left to survive in the bakery minigame: 5, minus 1 as each round ends; at 0 you win and are paid the rounds' rewards. Set back to 5 after the minigame.
vhint.TowerDefense.roundsremaining = 面包店小游戏中还需挺过的轮数：5，每轮结束时减 1；到 0 时你获胜并获得各轮的奖励。小游戏结束后重设为 5。

# Core[Lock-Game]
# en: True while a scene, talk or transition is running; the map, travel keys, room buttons and the Talk button do nothing until it is false again.
vhint.Core.Lock-Game = 场景、对话或过渡进行期间为真；在它重新为假之前，地图、出行按键、房间按钮和 Talk 按钮都不起作用。

# Core[Start-Transfer]
# en: Set true by a map or travel button to start the trip to the place in 'Upcoming-Level'; the travel script sets it back to false when the move is done.
vhint.Core.Start-Transfer = 地图按钮或出行按钮把它设为真，以开始前往「Upcoming-Level」中的地点；移动完成后出行脚本把它设回假。

# Core[Cash]
# en: Money the player has (200 at the start, capped at 50,000,000). Shops and payments take from it; the nightly Starmaker payout, jobs and winnings add to it.
vhint.Core.Cash = 玩家拥有的钱（开始时 200，上限 50,000,000）。商店和付款从中扣除；每晚的 Starmaker 结算、工作和奖金会增加它。

# Core[Daily-Income]
# en: Starmaker income, never paid out or lowered: photos (+25), shoots and some scenes raise it. At 5000+ Frank, the insurance man, can visit the garage on Mondays.
vhint.Core.Daily-Income = Starmaker 收入，从不发放也不降低：照片（+25）、拍摄和一些场景会提高它。达到 5000+ 时，保险员 Frank 可能在周一来车库拜访。

# Core[Follower]
# en: Followers on the Starmaker page; photos, shoots and events add them. Sleeping on a Tuesday cuts them to 60% unless Celeste's quest is done.
vhint.Core.Follower = Starmaker 页面上的关注者；照片、拍摄和事件会增加关注者。周二睡觉会把它削减到 60%，除非 Celeste 的任务已完成。

# Core[Subscriber]
# en: Subscribers on the Starmaker page; each night's payout pays per subscriber. Sleeping on a Friday usually cuts them to 40% (50% with the Loyal Makers perk).
vhint.Core.Subscriber = Starmaker 页面上的订阅者；每晚的结算按订阅者支付。周五睡觉通常会把它削减到 40%（有 Loyal Makers 天赋时为 50%）。

# Core[Debt]
# en: Josef's debt, 1,000,000 at the start. Set to 0 when it is paid: gifting Josef $1,000,000 at his office, Emma's sauna deal, or telling Josef to leave.
vhint.Core.Debt = Josef 的债务，开始时为 1,000,000。还清时设为 0：在他的办公室送给 Josef $1,000,000、Emma 的桑拿交易，或让 Josef 离开。

# Core[Auto-Skip]
# en: Auto-skip switch, flipped by a key press outside minigames. While true, lines in the empty dialogue box skip by themselves; the main box uses its speed button.
vhint.Core.Auto-Skip = 自动跳过开关，在小游戏之外按一个键切换。为真时，空白对话框中的台词会自动跳过；主对话框使用它的速度按钮。

# Core[Cash-Before]
# en: Cash when the register sound last played: a Cash change to at least this (not by idle income) plays the sound and updates it. Spending leaves it high.
vhint.Core.Cash-Before = 收银机声音上次播放时的现金：Cash 变化到至少这个数（不是由挂机收入导致）时会播放声音并更新它。花钱后它保持在高位。

# Core[Day]
# en: Day of the week: 1 = Monday to 5 = Friday. Goes up by 1 each night and back to 1 after Friday; the skip button in your room jumps it ahead.
vhint.Core.Day = 星期几：1 = 周一到 5 = 周五。每晚加 1，周五之后回到 1；你房间里的跳过按钮会让它提前。

vhint.RacingMinigame.rac-pointsneeded = 要赢得街头赛车，乘客的快感计量条必须达到的值。游戏中没有任何内容改变它。

# Data_Bestiary[rats-killed]
# en: Nothing in the game sets it: only the task counters of a rat quest read it, and no script in the game starts that quest.
vhint.Data_Bestiary.rats-killed = 游戏中没有任何内容设置它：只有一个老鼠任务的目标计数器读取它，而游戏中没有脚本开始那个任务。

# Cooldown3[spirti-katehimari-weekcd]
# en: Daily lock on the Shrine's random Kate or Himari talk after a spirit sword fight: set when it plays, cleared each night.
vhint.Cooldown3.spirti-katehimari-weekcd = 灵体剑斗之后 Shrine 的 Kate 或 Himari 随机对话的每日锁：播放时设置，每晚清除。

# Cooldown3[lookfornorah-cd]
# en: Daily lock on meeting Norah at the public pool: set by her chance meeting or by '(Look for Norah)', which it then hides. Cleared each night.
vhint.Cooldown3.lookfornorah-cd = 在公共泳池遇见 Norah 的每日锁：由她的偶遇或「(Look for Norah)」设置，随后会隐藏后者。每晚清除。

# Cooldown3[lookforvanessa-cd]
# en: Set when you talk with Vanessa at church and cleared each night, but nothing reads it: '(Look for Vanessa)' is not limited by it.
vhint.Cooldown3.lookforvanessa-cd = 你在教堂与 Vanessa 交谈时设置，每晚清除，但没有任何内容读取它：「(Look for Vanessa)」不受它限制。

# Cooldown3[tonygarage-cd]
# en: Daily lock on Toni's Wednesday talk in the garage (50% once she works for you): set when it plays, cleared each night.
vhint.Cooldown3.tonygarage-cd = Toni 周三在车库的对话的每日锁（她为你工作后 50%）：播放时设置，每晚清除。

# Cooldown3[evelyn-dailysmollexperi]
